title: Delete or wire up tool/curate_curricula/sefaria_settings.py — a vestigial placeholder never referenced by the documented workflow

why: The file documents its own invocation via a PYTHONPATH trick that nothing else in the repo uses; README.md's actual Setup section instead has the developer hand-write a real sefaria/local_settings.py inside the external Sefaria-Project checkout. recommendation: Delete the file. If it's meant to become the real settings module, give it actual content and wire the PYTHONPATH invocation into README.md's Setup steps.
